description: Builds the email-safe HTML signature (table + inline styles, the same bytes as prosignature.co/email-signature-generator) for one person. Returns html, a plain-text version, an edit_url that opens the generator prefilled, and install steps for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail. The output is the free plan: four layouts, six accent colours, no logo or photo, and a small clickable "Created with ProSignature" credit line under the signature (Pro removes it). Nothing is installed or stored.

phone.description: Phone, as it should read; the tel: link keeps digits and +

website.description: Website: bare domain (https:// is added) or an http(s) URL

name: create_signature
title: Create an email signature (free, no account)
